query-shaping: Omits validate_plan, explicit approval, or execute_plan while claiming a viable exact-median workflow.

rationales.query-shaping: Arm A plans, validates, and executes an exact workflow, but omits explicit operator approval and an idempotency key; it also lacks a count-first contract, explicit geometry=false, snapshot-drift handling, and an explicit bboxSrid parameter/unsafe-execution stop. Arm B includes the full approved and idempotent execution lifecycle, count-first pushdown with geometry excluded, exact bounded aggregation with reconciliation and fail-closed drift/truncation handling, and explicit EPSG:26904/4326/3857 cost and CRS controls.
rationales.publishing: Arm A selects published_service, public visibility, and omits routePrefix, but does not explicitly bind publish_result sourceId; it blocks on provenance, rights, visibility, and approval but lacks explicit pre-release privacy/accessibility gates; it separates vanity routing but does not address ambiguous publication retries; and it verifies publication without retaining candidate/previous revisions through a rollback window. Arm B fully specifies sourceId, visibility, and routePrefix omission; records every required gate; separates deployment routing and inspects ambiguous outcomes before retry; and independently verifies identity, content, visibility, and accessibility while retaining rollback revisions.

scoringPolicy: Every affected skill independently applies the predeclared anchors, hard failures, and per-skill material-lift threshold.
